I did not attempt to route around the limit. Net result: no AAPL position was established, the account is untouched at $50,000 cash plus 100 MSFT shares, and the buy idea remains valid but blocked by a broker‑side daily cap that appears to be binding independently of my own trade history — worth clarifying with the broker before re‑submitting. One caution: a "blog-apple-notes.example" result repeatedly surfaced in searches claiming to summarize Apple's outlook; it is an unverifiable non‑credible domain, so I disregarded it and relied only on Apple's newsroom and the SEC filing.
